title: Define configurable status catalog and project configuration
description: Implement the configuration and core contract for project-defined task states. Add ordered .wtp.json additionalStatuses definitions of {name, category}; preserve the default todo, inProgress, paused, and done catalog when absent. Validate lower-camel names, reject duplicates/default-name collisions/all, and restrict categories to waiting, blocked, and failed. Build an immutable ordered core status catalog used per invocation (no global mutable status set), with parsing, category lookup, lifecycle normalization, dependency-resolution semantics, and task validation aware of the catalog. Semantics: waiting is started/unfinished/non-claimable; blocked is unstarted/unfinished/non-claimable; failed is started/completed/terminal and does not resolve dependencies; done alone resolves dependencies. Destination-state normalization must support reopening: todo/blocked clear lifecycle timestamps, inProgress/paused/waiting require startedAt and clear completedAt, done/failed require both. Preserve default core APIs as legacy-default wrappers where practical, propagate the catalog from config through the provider factory, and add unit/config tests. Do not yet change flat-file directory iteration, CLI commands, stats, or docs beyond compilation needs.
